title: Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable | Delay 6�<9 hrs | AC Wallet (20%) | VIP Profile
description:
Validates Tier 2 flight disruption compensation for a customer with a designated VIP profile where the customer selects AC Wallet payout. A 7-hour controllable delay on a single domestic leg (Flight AC 431, YUL to YYZ) falls within the APPR 6 to <9hr delay band. The system identifies the VIP profile status and linked active loyalty account, validates VIP priority tagging, and triggers the APPR dual payment offer. The customer selects AC Wallet with the 20% top-up applied on the Tier 2 statutory base ($700 CAD base + 20% top-up = $840 CAD AC Wallet). Confirms that DDS returns EL-02, Persona IDV passes, CyberSource returns GREEN, the compensation record routes to EIP/iFly, and Claims Dashboard reflects the VIP tag and tier attributes in read-only resolved state.
